The '''''Starbreeze''''' was the personal [[Mu-type shuttle]] of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Laren Omas]] of the [[Republic Army]]'s [[Republic Special Forces Division|Special Forces Division]] during the [[Great Galactic War]].<ref name="Frigid Expedition" />

==History==
In [[3665 BBY]],<ref name="Gnost" /> Omas and the ''Starbreeze'' were shot down over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Battle of Hoth (Great Galactic War)|Battle of Hoth]].<ref name="Frigid Expedition" /> [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Layek Davos]] discovered the shuttle and hid in the shuttle bay of the ''[[Star of Coruscant]]'' after filling it with riches, as a retirement plan. In [[3642 BBY]] he returned to Hoth and allied himself with [[White Maw]] pirates to retrieve the shuttle. At the same time [[Ardun Kothe]] ordered [[Cipher Nine]] to retrieve the shuttle, which Cipher accomplished, beating both pirates and the Admiral to it. Kothe needed the ship to later gain access to the [[Shadow Arsenal]].
